newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan leasing firm in Egyptian joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan leasing firm in Egyptian joint venture.

text.p: Orix Leasing Pakistan Ltd (OLP) said on Monday it had launched a leasing company in Egypt in partnership with leading Egyptian and international financial institutions.

An OLP statement said the joint venture company -- Orix Leasing Egypt -- had paid-up capital of 228 million rupees ($5.6 million) and would be managed by the Orix Group under a technical assistance agreement.

It will be the first leasing company in Egypt, with other sponsors being the National Bank of Egypt, Commercial International Investment Corporation, International Finance Corporation and Orix Corporation of Japan, the statement said.
It said the company would be OLP's second joint venture abroad, the first being the Oman Orix Leasing Co SAOG launched in Oman in 1994.
Orix Corporation of Japan has a 40 percent stake in Orix Leasing Pakistan Ltd.
